    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "The rows are a tree: every step is a treeitem with its level, labelled with name, kind, status, cost, tokens and time; aria-expanded on sub-agents"
      - listitem: Roving focus – only one row is in the tab order, so the waterfall is a single stop
      - listitem: The switch is two toggle buttons with aria-pressed in a labelled group
      - listitem: "\"Most expensive\" unfolds the step's sub-agents, opens it and moves focus to its row"
      - listitem: Long prompts and outputs scroll in their box and are then a tab stop, so the keyboard can scroll them
      - listitem: The run's state (Live, Done, Failed) is announced politely when it changes; ticks and grid lines are hidden from assistive tech
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: New steps slide in as rows and their bars grow from where the step before ended
      - listitem: A running step's bar has a sheen and a soft glow at its leading edge; numbers that still climb shimmer
      - listitem: When the total outgrows the axis, it glides to the next round value and every bar follows
      - listitem: Switching between cost and tokens glides every bar to its new place and length
      - listitem: Details open under their row and close the same way; folding closes the sub-agent's rows
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything appears at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Built on a container query: wide, the steps sit on the left, the waterfall in the middle, the numbers on the right"
      - listitem: Under 720px the In and Out columns step aside – in the tokens view the step's tokens take the cost's place
      - listitem: "Under 520px each row stacks: name, cost and time on one line, the bar across the whole width under it"
      - listitem: Touch screens get larger targets for the switch and the chevrons
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass the whole list every time something changes – ids keep rows in place, new ids slide in
      - listitem: cost and tokens are the step's own; sub-agents add their children up
      - listitem: NaN, Infinity and missing numbers show as – and count as zero; a negative cost is a credit
      - listitem: For a live run update tokensOut, cost and duration of the running step as they come in
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-cwfc, e.g. --ui-cwfc-llm-bg / --ui-cwfc-llm-edge for LLM calls
      - listitem: The chevron and warning icons are Hugeicons Free (MIT) – keep the credit comment when you copy the file
